title: Level up
notices: Meeting Expectations: 1,000 skill points. Level 1 to Level 2.

recorded.text: You kept a thousand points today,
and nine hundred came from fixes you made yourself.
Add a test next time, and Exceeding is yours.

new.text: Level two. You kept a thousand points,
and nine hundred came from your own fixes.
So what would make the next one Exceeding?

lines.text: Because you can get to GTM roles, and these habits are the whole gap.
I push this hard because I know you can do it.
